ingredients.item: /2 large head napa cabbage , cut into 4 cm lengths
coarse salt , plus more to taste
fish sauce — or 1 tbsp soy sauce for the vegan table
scallions , sliced; 1/2 Asian pear , in fine matchsticks; 1 tsp sesame seeds

instructions.heading: Step 1
instructions.action: Gochugaru, fish sauce, garlic, ginger, and sugar worked to a paste, loosened with a tablespoon of the cabbage's rinse water; pear matchsticks and scallion folded through.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: the paste tastes complete and slightly over-strong (sweet-savory-hot with a raw gochugaru edge) — the cabbage's water rounds it within the hour.

instructions.heading: Step 2
instructions.action: The squeezed cabbage and the dressing tossed together by hand, massaged for a full minute so every leaf's surface takes the paste, sesame oil and seeds last.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: the bowl test, ten minutes after mixing: crisp, wet-crunchy leaves, the dressing clinging rather than pooling, the flavor fully arrived — bright, sweet-hot, green. No sourness, and none expected: geotjeori's identity is the absence of the ferment.

visualDonenessCues: the paste tastes complete and slightly over-strong (sweet-savory-hot with a raw gochugaru edge) — the cabbage's water rounds it within the hour.

storageNotes: Best within 3 hours, acceptable at a day refrigerated, wrong at two — this is a make-and-eat bowl.
Variations: cucumber-geotjeori (#B03's instant cousin); a spoon of the leftover dressing makes instant radish geotjeori; the fermented commitment is B01.
